entities.summary: Andy D. Bryant is the past chairman of the multinational semiconductor company Intel. He joined Intel in 1981 and previously served as the company's vice chairman, chief administrative officer and chief financial officer. He stepped down from his position as chairman of the board in January 2020 with intention of retiring from the board altogether by May 2020. He plans to remain as an executive adviser to the company. Bryant worked out of the company's offices in Hillsboro, Oregon, and lives in Portland. He also serves on the board of directors for McKesson Corporation and Columbia Sportswear.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As the past chairman of Intel, Andy Bryant played a crucial role in shaping the semiconductor industry and its impact on modern technology. His leadership helped drive innovation and growth, with Intel becoming one of the world's leading technology companies.
